page_title: LEN 2-2 MNT | Lens v Montpellier 19/05/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Thomas Leonard is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+4' Wahbi Khazri (Montpellier) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
90+3' Here comes a substitution. Elye Wahi is given a rest as he is replaced by Ayanda Sishuba (Lens).
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
87' Corner kick. Lens will have an opportunity.
82' Franck Haise prepares a substitution. Florian Sotoca is replaced by Morgan Guilavogui (Lens).
82' Franck Haise has decided to make a change. Wesley Said replaces Abdukodir Khusanov (Lens).
82' Christopher Jullien (Montpellier) looks like he won’t be able to continue.
80' Christopher Jullien (Montpellier) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
79' Here is a change. Akor Adams is going off and Michel Der Zakarian gives the last tactical orders to Issiaga Sylla (Montpellier).
79' Here's the change. Lucas Mincarelli leaves the pitch and Sacha Delaye (Montpellier) comes on as a substitute.

74' 2 - 2 Goal! Lucas Mincarelli (Montpellier) picks up the ball from a rebound and from the edge of the box he unleashes a low shot into the bottom left corner. Jean-Louis Leca is unable to keep the ball out of the net. It's 2:2.
74' Akor Adams (Montpellier) tries his luck and takes a shot from inside the box. His effort on goal is blocked by a defender.
70' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Przemyslaw Frankowski (Lens) replaces Ruben Aguilar.
70' Substitution. Angelo Fulgini is replaced by Adrien Thomasson (Lens).

65' Great solo effort by David Pereira da Costa (Lens) as he beats two defenders before firing in a drive from just outside of the box towards the right side of the goal. The goalkeeper is ready and makes an amazing save.
59' The substitution is prepared. Wahbi Khazri (Montpellier) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Othmane Maamma.
59' Michel Der Zakarian has decided to substitute Tanguy Coulibaly and he is replaced by Yann Karamoh (Montpellier).
58' 2 - 1 Goal! Silvan Hefti manages to prod the ball to Othmane Maamma (Montpellier) after a melee inside the box, and he needs no second invitation to slot the ball into the roof of the net. 2:1.
55' Chance! Elye Wahi (Lens) took a nice pass in his stride in the box, but scuffed his shot just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Montpellier will have a goal kick.
49' Facundo Medina (Lens) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
47' A sweeping move ends with a pass to Elye Wahi (Lens) inside the box. He lets fly towards the middle of the goal, but Dimitry Bertaud was watching it all the way and makes a comfortable save.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Michel Der Zakarian probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Khalil Fayad. He is replaced by Leo Leroy (Montpellier).
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+5' Thomas Leonard has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+2' 2 - 0 Deiver Machado (Lens) receives a killer pass, finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper and coolly sends the ball into the back of the net.
45' We will have 4 min. of added time.
43' Khalil Fayad (Montpellier) takes a mid-range free kick and his stunning strike crashes against the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Lens will have a goal kick.
41' Corner kicks – 0:0.

37' Dimitry Bertaud pulls off a fantastic save! Florian Sotoca (Lens) attempts to head home after a precise cross into the box. He aims his header towards the top of the net, but the effort is kept out.
32' Deiver Machado (Lens) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
31' The game is interrupted now, Deiver Machado (Lens) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
26' Florian Sotoca (Lens) releases a decent shot towards the middle of the goal from the edge of the box, but it's comfortably gathered by Dimitry Bertaud.
21' A spell of possession for Lens in an attempt to control the game.

16' Elye Wahi (Lens) latches onto a short pass just on the edge of the box and shoots. The effort beats the keeper but comes back off the right post. Close! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Montpellier.
5' Referee Thomas Leonard points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. Elye Wahi (Lens) goes wild in celebration.
5' The Lens players halt their celebrations as referee Thomas Leonard makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
4' 1 - 0 It's in the back of the net! Florian Sotoca puts the ball on a plate for Elye Wahi (Lens), who has an easy finish with a header into an empty net. The score is 1:0.
4' Facundo Medina (Lens) latched onto a loose pass on the edge of the box and let fly, but Dimitry Bertaud saw it all the way and made a fine save to deny him.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are on the pitch and Lens will have the kick-off.
Thomas Leonard was nominated as the referee for this game.
